content: For patients with type 2 diabetes and heart failure who are hospitalized, it is recommended to initiate or continue treatment with SGLT2 inhibitors, provided there are no contraindications and the patient is recovering from the acute illness. SGLT2 inhibitors have been shown to be effective in hospitalized patients by reducing hyperglycemia and shortening the duration of insulin infusion without increasing the risk of hypoglycemia. During hospitalization and at the time of discharge, adjustments to the treatment regimen should be made, particularly for patients with heart failure. Additionally, SGLT2 inhibitors should be discontinued three days prior to any surgical procedure.
